name: Watchfloor
signature: Dark-first operations, built to Marcel Kargul's dark grammar (near-black #08080a field, a hairline cell grid that runs the page, numbered sections, pixel-matrix art lit by one accent) with Rico-grade product windows (neutral grey surfaces, white pill primary, real-looking agent work). Signal amber is the only colour: it means 'something needs a human'.

personality.typeVoice: Plain, exact, calm under pressure; sentences an on-call engineer would write.

owned: A hairline cell grid (rails + rules) that frames every section, Marcel-style; content sits in cells, never floats
Pixel-matrix art made of square cells that light in amber where a human is needed and cool to white when resolved
Numbered section and tab labels in mono (01, 02...)
Product windows at Rico grade: #161616-#1c1c1c greys, 1px #ffffff0f edges, white pill primary
never: purple or blue gradients behind type
